modelOverview: Launched in 2007, the Ballon Bleu de Cartier is instantly recognisable for its rounded, pebble-like case and the fluted crown set with a blue cabochon. The 28mm size is the smallest in the range and is offered on quartz movements, frequently with diamond-set bezels and dials, making it the most jewellery-led proportion of the line.

W4BB0034.materials: Stainless steel case and interchangeable steel bracelet; sapphire crystal
W4BB0034.bezel: Steel bezel set with 42 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.48ct)
W4BB0034.dial: Silvered sunray-brushed dial set with 19 brilliant-cut diamonds (0.08ct), Roman numeral XII and blued-steel sword-shaped hands; fluted steel crown set with a synthetic cabochon-shaped spinel
W4BB0034.description: The W4BB0034 is the diamond-set quartz Ballon Bleu de Cartier in 28mm, with 42 brilliant-cut diamonds around the bezel and 19 more as hour markers on a silvered sunray dial. It is worn on the interchangeable steel bracelet. Every piece we offer is sourced and independently authenticated before sale.

variants.Steel – Diamond Bezel: 28mm steel Ballon Bleu on a quartz movement, with a 42-diamond bezel, silvered sunray dial set with 19 diamond markers and blued sword hands, on the interchangeable steel bracelet.
